reason: A DeepSeek Harness web settings plugin for searching and browsing GitHub-hosted plugins, viewing repository details and README excerpts, and optionally obtaining configured-model explanations.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页设置中搜索和浏览 GitHub 插件，查看仓库信息与 README 摘要，并可请求配置模型进行插件说明。
summaries.en: Search and browse GitHub plugins in the DeepSeek Harness web settings, view repository details and README excerpts, and optionally request explanations from the configured model.

capabilities: Queries the public GitHub search API
Displays repository metadata and README excerpts
Requests configured model explanations of plugins
Provides plugin installation information and links
